n_items: <int> Number of distinct items to be produced.
n_periods: <int> Number of discrete time periods in the planning horizon.
capacity: <list[float], length n_periods> Total available production and setup time in each period.
initial_inventory: <list[float], length n_items> Stock on hand for each item at the start of the first period.
demands: <list[list[int]], shape [n_items][n_periods]> Quantity of each item that must be fulfilled in each period.
setup_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [n_items][n_periods]> Fixed cost incurred when the production line is set up for each item in each period.
holding_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [n_items][n_periods]> Per-unit cost of carrying inventory of each item from one period to the next.
variable_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [n_items][n_periods]> Per-unit production cost for each item in each period.
setup_times: <list[list[float]], shape [n_items][n_periods]> Time consumed to set up the production line for each item in each period.
variable_times: <list[list[float]], shape [n_items][n_periods]> Time required to produce one unit of each item in each period.
big_M: <list[list[float]], shape [n_items][n_periods]> Maximum production quantity for each item in each period, given capacity and remaining demand.
